Two utterances from LibriSpeech dev-clean (speaker 1272), CC-BY-4.0,
https://www.openslr.org/12 (Panayotov et al., 2015).

`fleurs-es-419.wav` and `fleurs-ja-jp.wav` (with `translation.json`) are two test
utterances from FLEURS (Conneau et al., 2022), CC-BY-4.0,
https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs, converted to 16-bit WAV. Their English
references are the FLEURS en_us sentences with the same id. They check translation.
